findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Observed employee to fail to use a barrier to turn off hand sink. Educated employee on proper hand washing procedure. Ensure employees are properly washing hands prior to starting a new task or donning new gloves.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed facility to have no sanitizer buckets created during operation. Sanitizer was made in the triple sink for dishwashing, but there were no cloths present for sanitizing food contact surfaces such as prep tables, etc. Staff created a sanitizer bucket on site, so the violation is considered COS. Ensure there is a sanitizer bucket with cloths at all times to incentivize staff to properly sanitize food contact surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A).

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed nozzles of lemonade and tea dispensers to be soiled. Informed staff that nozzles need to be cleaned frequently to avoid accumulation of soil and debris. A follow-up is scheduled for 3/17/2025 to ensure the dispenser nozzles are clean to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Observed jugs of water and cans of soda stored on the floor in and around the walk-in drink cooler. Informed staff that food must be stored at least 6 inches off the floor. Proper food storage prevents the accumulation of pests in the facility as well as protects food items from cross-contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed hood in kitchen to be soiled with dust and grease. Informed staff that hood needs to be cleaned frequently to avoid dust and grease from falling into cooking food. Ensure hood is cleaned either in-house or by a third party company by next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed.
findings.comment: Observed mop bucket to contain old soiled mop water. Informed staff that all waste water must be properly removed from facility and can never be left overnight. Staff emptied mop bucket while on site. Ensure mop bucket is emptied immediately after use and waste water is not being retained in facility.
findings.citation_text: 5-402.13 Conveying Sewage. SEWAGE shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an APPROVED sanitary SEWAGE system or other system, including use of SEWAGE transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed both hand sinks in kitchen as well as mop sink to not be properly sealed to wall. Ensure sinks are sealed to wall using a sealant such as caulking to avoid moisture retention between the sink and wall. Repairs should be completed prior to next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.comment: Observed ventilation in bathroom to be inoperable and hanging from ceiling. Informed staff that bathrooms require adequate ventilation to keep room free of excessive vapors, obnoxious odors, fumes, and heat. Ensure ventilation is repairs prior to next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-304.11 Mechanical. If necessary to keep rooms free of excessive heat, steam, condensation, vapors, obnoxious odors, smoke, and fumes, mechanical ventilation of sufficient capacity shall be provided.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.comment: Observed employee drink without lid stored with food in dry storage room. Informed staff that a designated area is needed for employee drinks to avoid cross-contamination. Ensure a designated area is used for employee food/drink prior to next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-403.11(A) Designated Areas. (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use TOBACCO PRODUCTS shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Observed no paper towels available for use at hand sink located next to 3 compartment sink in kitchen. Paper towels were provided during inspection. 

6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
Observed swinging gate dividing kitchen and retail store to have several pieces of duct taped attached. Remove duct tape or replace swing gate. 

4-101.19: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed floors underneath shelving and equipment in kitchen to be soiled with debris. Pull shelving and equipment away from wall, and clean floors. 

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed soda fountain counter to be soiled with soda syrup and food debris. Clean and sanitize soda fountain counter

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed several ceiling tiles in lobby to be soiled with black mold. Clean and sanitize ceiling tiles to remove black mold. 

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED. 
Observed employee wash hands and then proceed to turn off the faucet handle with bare hands. The employee was coached immediately and rewashed hands properly.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
3-304.14: (A) Cloths in-use for wiping FOOD spills for TABLEWARE and carryout containers shall be dry and used for no other purpose. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. (C) Cloths in-use for wiping raw animal FOOD surfaces shall be separate from other cloths. (D) Dry wiping cloths and sanitizing solution shall be free of FOOD debris and other soil. (E) Containers of sanitizing solution shall be stored off floor and used in manner to prevent contamination. (F) SINGLE-USE disposable sanitizer wipes shall be used in accordance with EPA labels. 
A wet wiping cloth is observed to be sitting on the rail of the pizza prep table. The soiled wet wiping cloth was placed into laundry. Take care to properly store wet wiping cloths when finished using them.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
4-903.11: (A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination. 
Observed a box of 30oz single use Jcups stored on the floor in the back hall. Store single service items properly protected.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. 
The front of the soda fountain/drink station is sticky with soda residue. The area around the single use lid storage is heavily soiled. Clean and maintain clean.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment: 2-301.14: Observed food employee put on new pair of gloves without first washing hands.  Wash hands before each new glove use. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.comment: 3-101.11: Observed moldy tomatoes in walk in cooler.  Tomatoes were discarded. FOOD shall be safe, unADULTERATED, and, honestly presented.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 4-602.13: Observed soft serve ice cream machine to be soiled with dried ice cream residue.  NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: 6-501.16: Observed mop head to be stored head down in dirty mop water bucket. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: No bare hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed
findings.citation_text:
3-301.11 (Pf) Food employee is not minimizing bare hand contact with foods that are not in a ready to eat form. Employee shall use suitable utensils or gloves to minimize bare hand contact with these foods. Reference 3-301.11.
Observed employee to place two large tea bags in the filter basket and mash them down with her bare hands. The tea brews but the temperature of the tea bags only reached 85F. Handle tea bags like the ready to eat products they are by protecting them from contact with bare hands. Employee and manager were coached.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11  (Pf) Hand washing sink blocked by a stack of soda boxes and other soda. The soad was immediately moved to a proper storage locatio. Hand washing sinks must be accessible at all times. Reference 5-205.11. Do not block hand sinks.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A)  (Pf) Observed the nozzles of the soad fountian to be soield with mold in the areation holes. These areation devices are food contact surfaces. Wash, rinse, sanitize food-contact surfaces routinely. Reference 4-601.11(A). Avoid the build up of soil on food contact surfaces with regular cleaning and sanitizing.

findings.title: Proper hot holding temperatures
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(1)  (P) BBQ chicken is 115°F and brisket is 128°F.  Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food is not maintained at 135°F, or above. Reviewed hot holding requirements and discussed HACCP concept with employee and person in charge. Inadequately held food was discarded. Reference 3-501.16(A)(1).

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.citation_text: 3-304.14  (C) In-use wiping cloths are not stored properly. Cloths used to wipe surfaces and equipment shall be held in proper sanitizer solution between uses. In-use cloths must be laundered daily. Reference 3-304.14. Sanitizing solution for wet wiping cloths was about 100ppm of Quat. Discussed potential issues including cleaning buckets nightly, letting the sanitizer run for 5 seconds before filling the bucket and pre wetting cotton towels with quat before adding them to the bucket. The sanitizer tested at 200ppm when these items were considered.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13  (C) Soil residue present on the lid holder at the soda fountain and the soda fountain drip tray. Clean all non-food contact surfaces frequently to prevent soil accumulation.  Reference 4-602.13. Maintain free of accumulated soil.
